name: Horng Terng Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: Horng Terng Automation Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor automation equipment. The company offers advanced indium processing and heatsink solution machine, high-pressure dispensing and lid attach machine, advanced flux jetting indium attach machine, film tim attach machine, substrate flux jetting, and product exchanged machine; inspection machine; open and short testing solutions; and upper and lower covers and wiring system, die bond automated, heatsink pick and flip and inspection machine, and chip-on-wafer automated inline equipment. Horng Terng Automation Co., Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
